tei:titleStmt.tei:title: מָעוֹז צוּר
Maoz Tsur (Rock of Ages), singing translation by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi

tei:lg.tei:l: maˈoz tsur yeshuˈati lekha naˈeh leshabbeˈaḥ
tikkon bet tefillati vesham toda nezabbeˈaḥ
leˈet takhin matbeˈaḥ mitsar hamnabeˈaḥ
az egmor beshir mizmor ḥanukkat hammizbeˈaḥ
raˈot savˈa nafshi beyagon koḥi kala
ḥaiyai mereru vekoshi beshiˈbud malkhut egla
uvyado haggedola hotsiˈ et hassegulla
el parˈoh vekhol zarˈo yardu keˈeven bimtsula
devir kodsho heviˈani vegam sham lo shakatti
uva noges vehiglani ki zarim avadeti
veˈein raˈal masakhti kimˈat sheˈavarti
kets bavel zerubavel lekets shivˈim noshaˈti
kerot komat berosh bikkesh Agagi ben Hamdata
venihyata lo lefaḥ ulemokesh vegaˈavato nishbata
rosh yemini nisseˈta veˈoyev shemo maḥita
rov banav vekinyanav al haˈets talita
yevanim nikbetsu alai azai bimei ḥashmannim
ufartsu ḥomot migdalai vetimmeˈu kol hashmanim
uminnotar kankannim naˈasa nes lashoshannim
benei vina yemei shmona kaveˈu shir urnanim
ḥasof zeroa kodshekha vekarev kets hayshuˈa
nekom nikmat avadekha meˈumma hareshaˈa
ki arekha hashaˈa veˈen kets lime haraˈa
deḥeh admon betsel tsalmon hakem lanu roˈim shivˈa
